title: Governed Execution Runtime Composition Integration Contracts

phases.objective: Preserve the merged cross-Spec composition and provider-projection contracts while X0 adds passive no-secret evidence instrumentation without creating a new runtime authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the registered repository automation validator against the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Specs 011, 012, and 013 remain execution/context/catalog owners; X0 telemetry remains passive and non-authoritative; X1 remains gated behind external exact-head and live-Staging certification.
steps: Validate the integration manifest, completion ledger, ontology, authority graph, WordPress provider profile, X0 manifest, matched fixtures, and phase gates from the exact candidate tree.
Prove the integration kit owns composition/certification only while Specs 011/012/013 retain execution/context/catalog authority.

Prove X0 instruments GPT Tool, System Tool, Connector Plan, Agent Loop, and the pre-existing Sequential Plan adapter without changing routing, authority, provider dispatch, retries, readback, or result shape.
Prove matched F01/F03/F04/F05/F06 fixtures preserve functional and safety outcomes with no live provider or Production mutation benchmark.
Prove WordPress Abilities and custom MCP servers remain provider-side projections and WordPress raw SQL Breakglass remains excluded from normal System Tool projection.
Prove X1 cannot begin until external exact-head CI and required live-Staging certification close Gate X0.
assertions: The integration kit never becomes a fourth execution, context, catalog, policy, grant, or provider authority.
Telemetry absence or emitter failure cannot change the measured operation outcome.
Unobserved counters remain unobserved rather than being converted into false zero evidence.
X0 adds no provider call, database write, migration, retry, permission grant, runtime cutover, external send, or Production mutation.
Matched fixtures use deterministic simulators and cannot be represented as live provider certification.
X1 may compare canonical composition against legacy behavior but may not call providers from the shadow path.
Unknown outcomes are reconciled before retry and context or connection substitution remains fail-closed.

phases.objective: Close X0 external certification, then implement X1 contract-composition shadow with zero provider calls from the shadow path.
blockers: The X0 candidate requires external exact-head GitHub Actions certification; the source tree cannot self-attest success.
The declared runtime impact requires live Staging certification before Gate X0 can close.
X1 implementation is prohibited until Gate X0 is externally certified.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Certify passive X0 telemetry on the exact candidate, then compile canonical composition in shadow mode
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: X0 preserves runtime behavior and produces reproducible no-secret evidence; after Gate X0 closes, X1 reaches zero unexplained authority, target, tenant, connection, provider, or WordPress binding mismatch without provider calls from the shadow path.
steps: Run exact-head repository CI and the registered X0 deterministic fixture suites.
Run required live-Staging certification without Production mutation or runtime cutover.
Only after Gate X0 closes, compile and compare canonical context, operation, policy, approval, provider and readback decisions without dispatch.
Compile the WordPress provider binding in shadow mode and prove no direct Ability invocation occurs.

phases.objective: Certify X2 through X7 read, DAG, approval, ledger/projection, mutation, provider and durable execution resilience.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Exercise selected composed read, preparation, provider, mutation, and durable workflows in non-Production
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Idempotency, locks, approvals, readback, unknown-outcome reconciliation, provider binding, restart recovery, and rollback remain equivalent or stronger than legacy execution.
steps: Certify read and DAG preparation paths.
Certify provider binding, approval frontier, ledger/projection split, bounded mutation, and durable recovery with fault injection.

phases.objective: Expose the certified execution surface to bounded internal/tenant cohorts while retaining legacy fallback.
blockers: Resilient certification through selected X2-X7 gates is incomplete.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Use certified composed execution adapters under bounded rollout flags
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Semantic parity, provider readback, latency, duplicate-mutation, rollback, isolation and WordPress provider evidence remain within declared gates.
steps: Enable selected read and low-risk operation cohorts.
Measure parity and rollback readiness before each expansion.

phases.objective: Complete X8/X9 public-surface and percent-rollout closeout only after governed Production authority exists.
blockers: Canary acceptance, Production promotion authority, and reversible cutover evidence are absent.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Promote an exact certified composed execution release through governed Production promotion
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production runs intended revisions with equivalent-or-stronger authorization, provider binding, readback, evidence, recovery, and reversible legacy retirement.
steps: Verify exact release identity and promotion authority.
Run bounded Production readback, provider certification readback, rollback drill, and post-merge audit before retirement decisions.
